items.html: Now the reason they are thirteen is that, since the upper one's ten Sefirot are never all clothed within the ten Sefirot of the lower one — only the lower seven of the upper one alone, while the upper three remain revealed — it follows that the lower seven of the upper one are clothed within all the ten Sefirot of the lower one. And certainly the upper three must illuminate below, and it is impossible for the lower one to be entirely lacking the illumination of the upper three, for if so, how could it contain ten complete [Sefirot]? Therefore the lower one must have three additional ones, in order to receive illumination from the upper three of the upper one. Thus they are thirteen. Hence there is no aspect in the world — whether in Arich Anpin, whether in Aba veIma, and in ZON — that does not contain thirteen aspects. Remember this rule, and it will be further explained.
